phase: initial (frozen, written before any command execution)
overall_reason: The update replaces raft.applyConfChange with the confchange.Changer (simple + joint consensus, ConfChangeV2, AutoLeave, LearnersNext) and refactors RawNode Ready/Advance. For the V1 conf-change workload the spec already models, three requirement changes are test-backed: AddLearner on an existing voter now DEMOTES (old: ignored), removing an unknown peer is a no-op (old: panic), and any change leaving zero incoming voters is refused by panic (old: allowed, voters={}). These invalidate EffectContract and the shared ConfigAfter/ConfigOf helper (which silently changes the meaning of ConfigurationOrigin, ConfigurationTransitionSafety, SnapshotBacking, ReadBasis). Joint consensus adds a two-majority quorum obligation that flat-voter observers (QuorumAccounting, ReadBasis, DurableObligations) cannot express, and auto-leave makes Advance append a log entry, which AckPreservation forbids. Most other properties are kept unchanged; several suspected implementation defects (V2 entries ignored by numOfPendingConf, duplicate auto-leave proposals, joint ConfState dropped by restore/newRaft, Config.Clone drops AutoLeave) must stay detectable, not be absorbed by property edits.
